title: Intraoperative Optical Coherence Tomography for Ophthalmic Surgical Guidance - Cornea
official: Intraoperative Optical Coherence Tomography for Ophthalmic Surgical Guidance - Cornea
summary: Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) image data will be evaluated for image quality and used to test post-processing algorithms to improve detection sensitivity for ophthalmic diseases.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults (\>18 years) with diagnosis of cornea transplant (keratoplasty)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children or adults unable to consent
* Healthy adults (\>18 years) without diagnosis of cornea transplant (keratoplasty)
